xmldoc.short_description: Remove small connected components from a binary image.

param_input_item.param_description: Input binary image. Nonzero values are treated as true.
Minimum connected-component size to keep, as a nonnegative integer scalar.

param_output_item.param_description: Logical image after small components are removed.

description.p: Remove small connected components from a binary image. minSize must be a nonnegative integer scalar. Supported connectivities are 4 and 8.
